# rms_companies (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of all Teltonika RMS Companies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_companies" "all" {}

output "company_names" {
  value = data.rms_companies.all.companies[*].company_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `companies` (Attributes List) List of companies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--companies))
- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.

<a id="nestedatt--companies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `companies`

Read-Only:

- `company_name` (String) Company name.
- `device_count` (Number) Number of devices.
- `id` (Number) Company ID.
- `parent_id` (Number) Parent company ID.
